case.question: How much notice must a permanent employee give before resigning?
case.reference: The Acme employment terms say 30 calendar days for a permanent employee and the handbook says 60 for confirmed employees: the documents disagree, and the app should say so instead of saying it does not know.

failing_result.answer: I don't know based on the provided documents.

corrected_result.answer: A permanent employee must provide 30 calendar days of written notice before resigning. [source: Acme-Employment-Terms-2026.md]

why: Two documents answer a plain notice question, and the app said it did not know: four copies of the same boilerplate passage filled every slot.
